description: The highest-severity scoring actions in range, one row per action and weight, placed by how often each happened. Rarest is on the left, so the top-left corner is rare and high-severity: where to look first. A failed change scores 40 whatever it changed, so it gets its own row, marked (failed). Hover a point for how many identities did it and when.

text.expr: length(data('actions')) > 12 ? 'Top 12 of ' + length(data('actions')) + ' scoring actions, by severity then rarity · the rest are in Why these identities scored' : length(data('actions')) ? length(data('actions')) + ' scoring actions, by severity, rarest first within a weight' : 'No scoring actions in range'

url.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL OR attributes.event.outcome == "failure" OR attributes.event.action IN ("invalidate_apikeys","anonymous_access_denied") OR (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) | EVAL risk = CASE(attributes.event.action == "invalidate_apikeys", 45, attributes.event.action == "anonymous_access_denied", 35, attributes.elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, 50, attributes.event.outcome == "failure", 40, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND attributes.event.action IN ("workflow_run","workflow_test","workflow_execution_cancel"), 10, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND (attributes.event.type == "deletion" OR attributes.event.action == "rule_disable"), 30, (resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((attributes.event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR attributes.event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))), 25, 0) | WHERE risk > 0 | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | STATS events = COUNT(*), identities = COUNT_DISTINCT(actor), first_ts = MIN(@timestamp), last_ts = MAX(@timestamp) BY action = attributes.event.action, risk | EVAL label = CASE(risk == 40 AND NOT (action LIKE "*fail*" OR action LIKE "*denied*"), CONCAT(action, " (failed)"), action) | SORT risk DESC, events ASC, action ASC | LIMIT 200

axis.title: Occurrences in range (log scale) · rarer to the left
